metadata.description: Plugins that let you reach your own omp sessions from other places on your own machines, and look after omp's local memory.

plugins.name: omp-session-control
plugins.description: Stop the running turn of an omp session and rename it from a local dashboard, over a private Unix socket. Inert until you turn it on.

plugins.name: omp-services
plugins.description: Sets up and checks the background services other omp plugins need: launchd and systemd user units, a heartbeat that runs health checks other plugins contribute, doctor. Nothing is installed until you confirm a plan.

plugins.name: omp-private-relay
plugins.description: A Collab relay that runs on your own machine, with a patched browser client and per-browser pairing, so session links never go through omp's public relay. Does nothing until you run its init.

plugins.name: omp-dashboard
plugins.description: A local dashboard for your own omp sessions: list, open (through your private relay), stop, rename, kill and start them, with per-browser pairing. Does nothing until you run it.

plugins.name: omp-memory
plugins.description: A command line for omp's local memory banks: list banks and sources, label folders, import memory files from other coding tools into the banks, back them up and check them. Read-only until you pass --apply.
